brief: show a progress bar on the screen while it counts down

input.request: Keep the existing focus timer behavior and hardware. Add a progress bar to the SSD1306 OLED while counting down, keeping the remaining time visible. Show elapsed session progress: empty at the start and full at zero remaining, calculated against the duration selected when the session starts. Freeze the bar while paused and reset it for a new session. Preserve the rotary encoder's duration adjustment and press-to-start/pause controls.
input.summary: Add an on-screen progress bar during the focus countdown.
Preserves the adjustable focus timer and press-to-start/pause controls while adding an elapsed-session progress bar that freezes when paused and resets for each new session.
